text:
{
  "protocol_id": "CTJ301UC201",
  "version": "1.1",
  "previous_version": "1.0",
  "spoken_summary": "Protocol version 1.1 updates study countries, randomisation stratification, eligibility criteria, secondary endpoints, and the visit schedule including PK visits and safety assessments. These updates affect site investigators, study coordinators, and data managers who must update the EDC build.",
  "changes": [
    {
      "id": "CH-1",
      "section": "Cover Page / Synopsis",
      "page": 1,
      "quote": "Multicenter, international, across Mainland China, Taiwan, Republic of Korea and Australia",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Replaced Germany with Australia as a participating country/region.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-2",
      "section": "Version of Protocol or Protocol Amendment",
      "page": 5,
      "quote": "VERSION OF PROTOCOL OR PROTOCOL AMENDMENT",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Added a Version of Protocol or Protocol Amendment table.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-3",
      "section": "2.2",
      "page": 24,
      "quote": "Change from Baseline to Week 12 in modified Mayo score (=full Mayo score excluding Physician’s Global Assessment (PGA) subscore).",
      "type": "endpoint",
      "summary": "Added three secondary endpoints per FDA guidance: change from Baseline to Week 12 in modified Mayo score, change from Baseline to Weeks 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12 in PGA score, and FDA-defined remission at Week 12.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-4",
      "section": "3.1.2",
      "page": 26,
      "quote": "Randomisation will be stratified by prior corticosteroids treatment (yes/no) and consent to participate in PK substudy (yes/no).",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Changed randomisation stratification factors from elevated CRP levels and stable conventional treatment to prior corticosteroids treatment (yes/no) and consent to participate in the PK substudy (yes/no).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update randomisation stratification fields on the RAND form to capture prior corticosteroids treatment and PK substudy consent."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-5",
      "section": "3.1.2",
      "page": 27,
      "quote": "At 1st dose: pre-dose and 0.5, 1, 2 (end of infusion), 6, 48, 144 (Day 6), and 240 (Day 10) h after the start of the 1st administration;",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Changed the PK blood sampling timepoint from 1.5 hours to 2 hours (end of infusion).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update the PKTPT codelist on the PK form to replace 1.5 h with 2 h (EOI)."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-6",
      "section": "3.3",
      "page": 29,
      "quote": "The SRC is an expert advisory group commissioned and charged with the responsibility of evaluating, primarily, cumulative safety data at regular intervals.",
      "type": "safety",
      "summary": "Renamed the Data Safety Monitoring Committee (DSMC) to Safety Review Committee (SRC) and updated its responsibility description.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-7",
      "section": "4.1.1",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "4. During Day -35 to Day-6 prior to Randomisation, an endoscopy subscore ≥2.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Shortened the screening endoscopy window in Inclusion Criterion 4 from Day -60 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation to Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update edit checks for the screening endoscopy date on ENDO/IE to enforce Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-8",
      "section": "4.1.1",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "and/or with medications containing 5-aminosalicylates (5-ASA) at no less than 2 g 5-ASA per day for at least 3 months and stable for at least 4 weeks prior to Randomization",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Lowered the minimum 5-ASA dose in Inclusion Criterion 5 from 3 g per day to 2 g per day.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-9",
      "section": "4.1.1",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "8. The subject should be able to read and write to understand and fill out Patient Diary.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Added Inclusion Criterion 8 requiring subjects to be able to read and write to understand and complete the Patient Diary.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add Inclusion Criterion 8 to the IE form."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-10",
      "section": "4.1.2",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "5. Current diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease unclassified, Crohn's disease, ischemic colitis, fulminant colitis and/or toxic megacolon, patients with ulcerative colitis limited to the rectum (ulcerative proctitis), infective enteritis, amebic bowel disease and intestinal schistosomiasis.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Replaced the term 'indeterminate colitis' with 'inflammatory bowel disease unclassified' in Exclusion Criterion 5.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-11",
      "section": "4.1.2",
      "page": 35,
      "quote": "17. Presence or history of active tuberculosis (TB) or latent TB infection, defined as 1) a positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold test at Screening, or 2) a positive T-spot test within 4 weeks of Randomisation and evidence of current or previous pulmonary tuberculosis by chest X-ray within 12 weeks of Randomisation.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Expanded Exclusion Criterion 17 to exclude patients with latent TB infection and defined the diagnostic criteria.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update the IE and TB forms to capture latent TB infection criteria including QuantiFERON-TB Gold, T-spot test, and chest X-ray."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-12",
      "section": "5.1",
      "page": 39,
      "quote": "Manufacturer: Octoplus Development B.V. (now as Dr. Reddy’s Research &Development B.V.) , Netherlands",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Corrected the IMP manufacturer name from OctoPlus N.V. to Octoplus Development B.V.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-13",
      "section": "5.1",
      "page": 39,
      "quote": "The infusion time is 2 hours.",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Changed the IMP infusion time from 2 hours ± 3 minutes to 2 hours.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Remove or relax the ±3 minute infusion duration edit check on the EX form."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-14",
      "section": "5.5.2",
      "page": 41,
      "quote": "It should be recorded in the subject’s source documents that the code is broken, why, when and by whom.",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Clarified that Sponsor unblinding details must be recorded in the subject's source documents.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-15",
      "section": "6.2.5",
      "page": 51,
      "quote": "At Visits 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 7.1, 7.2, 7,3, and 8.1, no other data will be collected.",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "The protocol schedule includes PK subgroup visits V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1, which are not present in the current EDC build.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add visits V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1 with their visit windows and PK form to the EDC schedule."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-16",
      "section": "6.1, Table 1",
      "page": 95,
      "quote": "Add TB test at safety follow-up visit.",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Added a TB test at the Safety Follow-up Visit (Visit 9).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add the TB form to Visit 9 (Safety Follow-up Visit)."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-17",
      "section": "6.1, Table 1",
      "page": 95,
      "quote": "Add Blood sampling for anti-TJ301 antibodies at Visit 3.",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Added blood sampling for anti-TJ301 antibodies (ADA) at Visit 3 (Day 14).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add anti-TJ301 antibody blood sampling collection to Visit 3."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-18",
      "section": "6.1, Table 1",
      "page": 95,
      "quote": "Remove physical examination on V3, V5 and V7.",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Removed physical examination assessments from Visits 3, 5, and 7.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Remove the physical examination form from Visits 3, 5, and 7."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-19",
      "section": "6.2.3",
      "page": 95,
      "quote": "Add diary dispensing and diary review",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Added diary dispensing and diary review to Baseline Visit (Visit 2).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add diary dispensing and diary review collection to Visit 2."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-20",
      "section": "7.1.1",
      "page": 53,
      "quote": "Note that the criteria of endoscopic appearance assessment in this study are DIFFERENT from the original criteria in (13). The Endoscopy subscore is modified so that a value of 1 does not include friability. Personnel responsible for endoscopic evaluation should NOT refer to the original criteria.",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Added a note emphasizing that endoscopic appearance assessment criteria are modified so that a subscore of 1 does not include friability.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-21",
      "section": "8.3",
      "page": 61,
      "quote": "Adverse events of special interest include adverse events observed in earlier clinical development of TJ301 and those resulting from blocking IL-6 signaling shown by other drugs or investigational products.",
      "type": "safety",
      "summary": "Added a description of Adverse Events of Special Interest (AESI) for TJ301 and IL-6 inhibitors.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-22",
      "section": "8.5.2",
      "page": 64,
      "quote": "Zhijia Han E-mail: zhijia.han@tigermed.net",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Updated the CRO safety contact from Haiyan Liu to Zhijia Han.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-23",
      "section": "Appendix 2",
      "page": 87,
      "quote": "HIV (HIV-1/2 Antigen and Antibodies)",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Added detailed assay specifications for screening of HIV, HBV, HCV, TB, EBV, and CMV infections.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-24",
      "section": "Appendix 3",
      "page": 89,
      "quote": "Instructions for recording the number of stools and their worst rectal bleeding over a 24-hour period:",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Added instructions for patients on filling out the Patient Diary for stool definition and rectal bleeding categories.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    }
  ]
}
